errors.text_span: starting at approximately 18 GB at near zero frames
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization. The description repeatedly states the starting memory is around 18 GB for multiple lines, but the actual starting values (at the first data point near x=0) vary, with VideoLLaMB-R starting closer to 15 GB and VideoLLAVA starting closer to 20 GB.

errors.text_span: at the final data point just past 1000 frames
errors.evidence: The final data point for the VideoLLaMB-R line is located exactly at the 1000 frames mark on the x-axis, not past it.
The color of the line for LLaVA-NeXT is teal or cyan, not blue.
